text:
emma: Quick sync — I'm opening a docs PR to consolidate troubleshooting for Too-Many-Requests/timeouts/context-limit fallbacks. Aim: one playbook with examples, SDK snippets (js/go/python), and a short migration note for teams that used older retry hacks. Need volunteers for quick reviews.

liam: I can draft the runtime-side guidance + minimal code examples for handling Retry-After + exponential backoff. Pasting quick JS pseudo-snippet:```js
if (resp.status === 429) {
  const retry = parseInt(resp.headers['retry-after'] || '1', 10) * 1000;
  await sleep(retry + Math.floor(Math.random()*200)); // jitter
  // on retry attempts: base * 2 ** attempt, cap at 10s
}
```

sara: I will add SDK examples in the repo (js/python) and include the client-side best practices (auto-retries off by default, recommend server-side proxies for multiplexing). Which PR is this?

emma: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/456 is the draft. I linked an early draft of the playbook under /errors/too-many-requests but link-check flagged some internal references.

alex: Two quick asks: 1) call out context_limit behavior across model families (some older Llama variants returned truncation+200, newer models return 413 or 400 depending on serving layer). 2) Add a small table mapping model variant -> observed error code -> recommended action. I'll take the table.

michael: Please also call out fallback routing: recommend enabling automatic fallback to a smaller compatible variant for soft degradation (e.g., gptx-4 -> gptx-4-small) and prefer KV-prefix caching when applicable to reduce token usage. That helped one customer avoid cascading 429s.

liam: Also adding a runtime note: if you see 429 + Retry-After absent, assume a default backoff (start 250ms * 2**attempt) and surface an observability tag so teams can see retry storms in traces.

ci-bot: PR checks started: docs-lint, link-check, spellcheck.

sara: For SDK snippets, questions: should we show both simple retry and resilient approach (idempotent retries, request dedupe via idempotency key)? I can include both.

emma: Yes include both. Also add a migration subsection: "From naive 3x fixed wait -> to Retry-After + exponential + canary fallback". Add a short checklist for infra teams to toggle fallback routing.

liam: Small example for server-side proxy header to preserve Retry-After:
```nginx
proxy_set_header Retry-After $upstream_http_retry_after;
proxy_pass_request_headers on;
```

alex: I've started the model-table draft in the PR comments. One gotcha: earlier docs used the term "context limit" interchangeably with "token-limited rejection" — let's standardize to "context limit error (413) / truncation" and add a note about how some deployments will trim vs reject.

sara: Pushed SDK snippets to github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples#branch/docs-429-snippets. Opened a small follow-up PR to fix formatting for the python backoff example.

ci-bot: docs-lint failed: broken link to internal playbook at /playbooks/rate-limits (404).

emma: I'll fix the link to the new consolidated playbook and remove the old pointer.

sara: Also added unit tests for the JS example (mock 429 + Retry-After) and a README note for how to test offline. Test command: `npm run test:examples`

liam: Note for ops: on high tail latency we sometimes see a burst of timeouts followed by 429s. Recommend doc callout about short-circuiting retries for latency-sensitive endpoints (e.g., don’t retry for low-latency UI calls; instead show a deterministic degraded UX).

michael: +1. We should include a short paragraph for product owners about UX tradeoffs (retry vs graceful degradation).

ci-bot: All checks passed. ✅ (docs-lint, link-check, spellcheck)

emma: Checklist before merge: 1) SDK snippets merged (sara) 2) model error table (alex) 3) runtime + nginx proxy + backoff examples (liam) 4) migration note + UX paragraph (michael) 5) internal link fix (emma). Assigning owners in PR. Please add final review comments by EOD. :thumbsup:

alex: Added a short example of the table and flagged an edge case where older customer infra strips Retry-After — added mitigation note.

sara: All SDK snippets merged and linked in the PR. I'll follow up with a short changelog entry.

emma: Thanks everyone — will merge after the last couple of review comments. If anything blocks, ping me directly.

michael: Nice work, this will cut down support tickets.

ci-bot: PR merged by emma — commit 3f9a7d2. Release note queued.
